license_coherence.reason: pyproject.toml declares MIT while README.md points readers and the license badge to the materially different authorial LICENSE.md surface.
license_coherence.providencia: Preserve all current surfaces; obtain explicit legal/editorial decision before changing package metadata or LICENSE.md, then bind the successor decision to a receipt.

layer_classes.LEGAL_TEXT: Terms intended as legal/licensing language; machine validators classify presence and consistency only.
layer_classes.TECHNICAL_PROVENANCE: Hashes, commits, DOI/custody references, artifact lineage, version history.
layer_classes.ETHICS_POLICY: Privacy, fairness, human review, rights, responsible disclosure, supply-chain ethics.
layer_classes.SYMBOLIC_NARRATIVE: Parables, spiritual/fractal/Verbo Vivo/Omega language used for meaning, navigation or pedagogy.
layer_classes.SCIENTIFIC_EVIDENCE: Data, method, statistic, computation, result and falsifier with provenance.

transformation_chain.boundary: requires source, method, sample/context and uncertainty
token labels evidence; token is not evidence by itself
cannot satisfy scientific or legal gates

transformation_chain.role: declared intent, requirement or contract objective
transformation_chain.boundary: never a proof, guarantee or observed runtime fact
requires executable input, output, test outcome and receipt
not an infinity claim and not evidence of unbounded capability

anti_regression: P0/P1 records require source, use, relation, providencia, falsifier and provenance.
Closed/verified/resolved urgency states require a non-empty receipt.
Parable/metaphor cannot be used as evidence or legal authority.
External File Library sources remain TOKEN_VAZIO repo-hash until imported/hash-bound.
Negative evidence and superseded uncertainty are preserved by successor records.
claim_allowed, certification_claim, auto_merge and auto_license_rewrite remain false.

R3.F_ok: license surfaces are explicit; ethics/parables have typed boundaries; urgency contract is anti-regression testable
R3.F_gap: canonical license expression + legal review + external-source hashes + formalized ethics/privacy procedures
R3.F_next: validate contract and urgency ledger, then reduce only evidence-backed TOKEN_VAZIO entries through successor receipts
